description: This file contains the implementation of the onboarding wizard in a SwiftUI-based application. It includes a model class managing wizard state and logic, bridging helpers for serialization, and a view for presenting individual wizard steps with various input types.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A @Observable class managing the state and operations of the onboarding wizard, including starting, submitting steps, cancelling, and internal state management.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the wizard if conditions allow, setting up the session and waiting for gateway readiness.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a user's response for a particular wizard step.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing wizard session if it is active.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the wizard's internal state to initial values.
